_comment: Example only. The owner registers the real entry at local scope for this repo, like the other NAS connections, not user scope (tier 3). It runs behind write-gate, so it has no tools until the agent runs `write-gate on synology-extras`. Placeholders in <angle brackets>. mcpServers goes in the MCP config; permissions goes in the client's settings.json.

env.NAS_PIN: sha256//<base64 SPKI hash, same value as BACKUP_NAS_PIN>
